title: Her father 'Judge': generous, kindly and strict
summary: People called her father 'Judge' because he was always at the courthouse. Humes says she resembles him, that her only-child home was open to friends without fathers, and that both parents were strict about school dances.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was thinking, you know, you told me some interesting things about your father. You said people used to call him 'Judge'.
Yes, they used to call him 'Judge'.
You said he was always in and out of the County Courthouse.
